name: Sister de She See
source:
Main character travels and comes to a church for a shelter. The apprentice sister gives in to his begging about mercy and supplies him with a room. But protagonist has his plans for this inexperienced nun.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-august-2004-sorauta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
